method: No printed contents (single long essay). Edition: 2006 reprint in Critical Review 18(1-3), printed pp. 1-74, downloaded from Taylor & Francis (pdf 1-2 = publisher download/terms page). Body = introduction + the author's own roman-numeral sections I-X, all found in text (most start mid-page, hence toc_check 'not found near top' warnings for those level-1 entries). Per rule 6 the sections are grouped into three level-0 divisions of 17, 20 and 28 pages, each listing its sections at level 1. Section IX (Summary) runs pdf 55-66 and contains the historical illustrations (French clerical question, abolition and the Republican party, the Nazi mass base). Endnotes start mid-page on pdf 68 just below the last lines of X. Conclusion, so the final half page of the conclusion falls on the Notes page.
